messages:
sarah: starting a config-only rollout for 'latency-floor' + small batch-size nudge. change window 22:00-23:30 PST. no model changes, just routing/limits/batching. deploy-bot queued.
deploy-bot: queued deploy config/refine/latency-floor@v2. initial canary 5%.
miguel: quick Q — are we touching tenant floors or routing weights only?
sarah: routing weights + default batch_size 8 -> 6, idle_timeout 250ms -> 200ms. no schema bumps.
ian: added observability targets: route-level p95/p99, kvcache miss, 5xx rate. @anita pls sanity.
anita: ack. adding temporary canary alert: if 5m p99 > baseline * 1.3 => auto-rollback.
observability-bot: canary rule created: canary_latency_guard (5m window, multiplier 1.3).
deploy-bot: canary applied at 5% — start 22:05.
ray: FYI some heavy tenants (tenant-42, tenant-88) show long seqs; recommend pinning those to legacy route to avoid KV pressure.
sarah: good call, pinning now: routing.pin = [tenant-42, tenant-88].
deploy-bot: routing.pin updated for canary.
miguel: logs show a small bump in kvmiss_rate: 0.012 -> 0.020. still under rollback threshold.
ian: can we limit batch growth on pinned tenants? propose max_batch_per_core=4 for pinned routes.
sarah: applying `batch.max_per_core=4` for pinned.
observability-bot: snapshot: p95 +8%, p99 +12%, kvmiss +0.008. within acceptable range.
anita: seeing a handful of 5xx from encoder-coldstart on one pod, but error rate is low and steady. keeping eyes.
ray: any chance to tweak KV warm TTL briefly? reduces coldstart pain.
sarah: can do a short-lived TTL tweak for canary: `kvcache.ttl=60s`. applying.
deploy-bot: `kvcache.ttl` updated for canary.
deploy-bot: progressed to 20% at 22:30.
miguel: synthetic perf-tests running — `./perf/latency_test.sh` passed against canary routes.
observability-bot: smoke evals OK. no canary alerts fired.
sarah: moving to 50% at 22:45. plan to finish rollout 23:10-23:20 if stable.
ian: I'll be on pager watch for the window. +1 from me.
anita: +1. monitoring retention will be kept for 2h.
ray: +1. leave pinned tenants on legacy route for 24h post-rollout.
deploy-bot: canary progressed to 50% -> 100% staged rollout started at 23:10.
miguel: no regression on tail latency in last 20m.
observability-bot: final rollout snapshot: p95 +6%, p99 +9%, kvmiss normalized. all checks green.
deploy-bot: rollout complete at 23:18.
sarah: release notes (internal): config-only rollout 3300012345 — changes: routing weight adjustments, default batch_size lowered, batch.max_per_core for pinned tenants, idle timeout reduced, kvcache.ttl temporary tweak. no model or infra updates.
anita: rollback plan recorded: revert to config/refine/latency-floor@v1 (routing weights + batch.* + kvcache.ttl -> 300s). manual rollback command: `/deploy revert config/refine/latency-floor@v2` or use deploy-bot rollback in the runbook.
ian: leaving a note: keep tenant pins for 24h then review.
observability-bot: added cost regression alert: if cost_delta > 12% notify #finance.
sarah: linked release tracker: https://internal.redwood/release/3300012345 and internal runbook snippet: ``
- if p99 spike > 30% for 5m -> `/deploy revert ...`
- if encoder 5xx spike > 1% -> pause rollout and triage
``
anita: logged metrics snapshot and closed checklist. will close monitoring 30m after now if no regressions.
sarah: thanks team — great coordination. :rocket:
